Application Data.NAME: Melody Instruments, LLC
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Melody Instruments, LLC specializes in the sale and repair of musical instruments, offering a wide range of products including guitars, pianos, and brass instruments. Our operations include both in-store retail sales and on-site repair services, ensuring high-quality craftsmanship and customer satisfaction. We provide comprehensive music instruction sessions, with a strong emphasis on hands-on demonstrations and instrument maintenance tips. Our team is composed of qualified technicians who are dedicated to preserving the integrity and quality of each instrument that comes through our doors. We maintain a secure storefront with alarm systems in place to prevent theft, and we conduct regular inventory audits to manage and protect our assets effectively.
